intro: 12 個行銷情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: The new packaging attracted many first-time buyers.
ex.zh: 新包裝吸引了許多首次購買的顧客。

ex.en: Discount coupons attract price-sensitive customers.
ex.zh: 折價券吸引對價格敏感的顧客。

note: attractive 有吸引力的;attraction 吸引力、景點

ex.en: Customers often compare prices online before visiting the store.
ex.zh: 顧客通常會先上網比價再到店裡。

ex.en: Our delivery time is short compared to other suppliers.
ex.zh: 與其他供應商相比,我們的交貨時間較短。

note: compare A with/to B;compared to/with 與⋯相比

ex.en: The two brands are in fierce competition for young consumers.
ex.zh: 兩個品牌正激烈爭奪年輕消費者。

ex.en: We lowered our prices to stay ahead of the competition.
ex.zh: 我們調降價格以領先競爭對手。

note: the competition 可指「競爭對手(統稱)」
compete 競爭;competitive 有競爭力的;competitor 競爭者

ex.en: The ad campaign consumed nearly half of the annual budget.
ex.zh: 這波廣告活動耗費了將近一半的年度預算。

ex.en: Younger consumers consume most of their media online.
ex.zh: 年輕消費者大部分的媒體消費都在網路上。

note: consumer 消費者;consumption 消耗、消費量

ex.en: The ad needs to convince viewers that the product is worth the price.
ex.zh: 廣告必須說服觀眾這項產品值這個價格。

ex.en: It took a strong testimonial to convince skeptical buyers.
ex.zh: 需要有力的推薦見證才能說服存疑的買家。

note: convince sb. that/of sth;convince sb. to V
persuade 較強調「說服去做某事」,convince 較強調「使相信」

ex.en: The brand is currently running a buy-one-get-one promotion.
ex.zh: 該品牌目前正在推行買一送一的促銷活動。

ex.en: Currently, most ad spending goes to social media platforms.
ex.zh: 目前大部分的廣告預算都投入社群媒體平台。

note: 課本原文誤植成「參與、涉入」,正確意思是「目前、現今」,等同 at present

ex.en: Retailers worry that the product is just a passing fad.
ex.zh: 零售商擔心這項產品只是曇花一現的流行。

ex.en: Unlike most fads, this trend has lasted for several years.
ex.zh: 不同於大多數的流行,這股風潮已經持續好幾年。

note: fashion 泛指時尚,fad 特指「短暫、來得快去得也快」的流行

ex.en: The campaign drew its inspiration from local street art.
ex.zh: 這次的廣告活動從當地街頭藝術中汲取靈感。

ex.en: Her success became an inspiration for the whole sales team.
ex.zh: 她的成功成為整個業務團隊的激勵來源。

note: inspire 啟發、激勵;inspiring 鼓舞人心的

ex.en: The company markets its products mainly through influencers.
ex.zh: 公司主要透過網紅來行銷產品。

ex.en: There is a growing market for eco-friendly packaging.
ex.zh: 環保包裝的市場需求正在成長。

note: marketing 行銷;marketable 有市場價值的

ex.en: Good copywriting relies heavily on the art of persuasion.
ex.zh: 好的文案很仰賴說服的藝術。

ex.en: The team used persuasion rather than discounts to close the deal.
ex.zh: 團隊靠說服而非折扣來成交。

note: persuade 說服(動詞);persuasive 有說服力的

ex.en: The new ad format proved highly productive for lead generation.
ex.zh: 新的廣告形式在開發潛在客戶上非常有成效。

ex.en: A productive marketing team can do more with a smaller budget.
ex.zh: 有效率的行銷團隊能用較少預算做出更多成果。

note: produce 生產;production 生產、製作;productivity 生產力

ex.en: Customer satisfaction scores rose after the redesign.
ex.zh: 改版後顧客滿意度分數提升了。

ex.en: We offer a full refund to guarantee your satisfaction.
ex.zh: 我們提供全額退費以保證您的滿意度。

note: customer satisfaction 顧客滿意度;to sb.'s satisfaction 令某人滿意
satisfy 使滿意;satisfied 感到滿意的;satisfactory 令人滿意的
